dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Anything I want to do? The human lifespan is limited to no more than a century, and we often find ourselves with endless desires and insufficient time.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: But we don't have to start being all deep and existential in a casual conversation... There's actually something I'm planning to do.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor is a large place. Sometimes, people get severely injured and become incapacitated, while others may land themselves in situations where it's difficult for them to ask for help.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: In either case, it is often well past the golden hour for treatment when the doctor finally arrives at the scene.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: People often wish for doctors to become more efficient, but I'm not able to teleport between places, and as a result, the best window for treatment is often missed.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: In situations like this, the patient should first try to help themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: There are many ways to render self aid before help arrives, but not everyone is aware of them.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: As a doctor, that's something within my power to change — I'm thinking of coming up with some ways to teach people basic first aid.

choices.text: I think that's a great cause.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Being a doctor comes with great responsibility, so I'm just trying to do my duty.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Having someone listen to me while I think aloud at length is already a great help.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I'll make sure to go over the details with you once I've put together a better plan.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I might need your help again when the time comes.

choices.text: Can I help in any way?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I've drafted a preliminary plan, but I still need to go over a few details to make the whole process more efficient.
